records.title: deps(deps-dev): bump fast-uri from 3.1.2 to 3.1.4 in the VS Code extension
records.release_claim: the packaged extension dependency graph includes the upstream fast-uri security fix
records.reason: Deferring a known security release would contradict the selected extension security posture.
records.non_claim: The dependency update does not change RIPR analysis semantics.

records.title: docs(output): publish the command-to-schema-version map
records.release_claim: machine consumers can identify the independent schema generation for each public command family
records.reason: The selected trust/editor/output changes span several independently versioned contracts; presenting one global schema version is materially misleading.
records.non_claim: The map does not guarantee compatibility across unrelated command families.

records.title: fix(xtask): reject TODO placeholders in the no-panic allowlist
records.release_claim: source policy cannot accept an unreviewed placeholder exception as governed approval
records.reason: This protects the source/release evidence environment rather than shipped runtime semantics.
records.non_claim: Does not alter RIPR's analysis or public support posture.

records.title: perf(xtask): build RIPR once and invoke the binary directly in fixtures and dogfood
records.release_claim: candidate fixture and dogfood proof runs the exact worktree binary without repeated cargo-run/link overhead
records.reason: This is valuable release-proof infrastructure and includes a CARGO_TARGET_DIR correctness fix, but it is not shipped product semantics.
records.non_claim: Faster proof execution does not strengthen the underlying analyzer evidence.

records.title: fix(xtask): warn when install-hooks writes a hook without the executable bit
records.release_claim: cross-platform contributors are warned when a Windows-created hook will not execute later under WSL or Linux
records.reason: Useful setup guidance with no runtime, package, or schema dependency.
records.non_claim: RIPR does not modify Git index permissions for untracked live hooks.

records.title: harden(init): generated workflow consumes doctor JSON for language detection
records.release_claim: generated CI derives enabled-language grouping from a typed doctor contract rather than unstable human prose
records.reason: The old sed parser could silently lose preview-language detection after copy changes and present incomplete CI output without a named failure.
records.non_claim: Typed detection does not promote preview evidence to blocking authority.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract the 47k-line test module out of main.rs
records.reason: Test names, module path, raw fixtures, suite totals, and required gates were reported unchanged; allowlist entries only repoint moved tests.
records.non_claim: The line reduction is not a product capability or support improvement.

records.title: refactor(xtask): extract the no-panic family from main.rs
records.reason: The semantic gate itself caught the required path repoints, suite totals conserved, and no policy meaning was intended to change.
records.non_claim: This does not close the remaining xtask decomposition or change panic policy.
